mechanics.title: Trash slot
mechanics.description: Drop an item into it to delete it. Taking the item out undoes the last deletion. A deny list prevents certain items from being trashed. Instant deletion can be enabled in config.

qol: Drag the slot to reposition; can be disabled per screen.
First-time hints explain how to toggle it.
commands_and_keybinds: T: show/hide trash slot (default per Modrinth)
Shift+Delete: delete all items of the same type under cursor
getting_started: Open your inventory and drop junk into the trash slot, or hover over an item and press Delete.
editor_notes: Requires Balm. Delete keys do not work in creative unless enabled, and items trashed in creative are lost permanently.
name: TrashSlot
summary: Adds a draggable trash slot to inventory screens for deleting unwanted items. The last trashed item can be taken back out.
